post.summary: Confirm the new account email with its code.
post.description: Finishes an email change started with account.email.change_start.
Sends a verification code to the new address. Not available to agents.

post.summary: Link a Google account to the signed-in user.
post.description: Links the Google account behind the given ID token. Not available to agents.

post.summary: Unlink Google from the signed-in user.
post.description: Removes the Google sign-in. Email code sign-in always remains available.

get.summary: Get the signed-in user's account profile.
get.description:
Use when you need the user's name, email address or preferred language.
Do not use to read academic data; use the academics, grading or schedule capabilities.

post.summary: Change or set the account password.
post.description: Change the password (or set the first one). Signs out all other sessions.

patch.summary: Update the display name or avatar.
patch.description: Change the signed-in user's profile. Not available to agents.

get.description: Lists active sessions of the signed-in user. Not available to agents.

delete.description: Revokes a session. Revoking the current session signs this browser out.

parameters.name: session_id

schema.description: Id of the session to sign out
schema.title: Session Id

parameters.description: Id of the session to sign out

post.description: Revokes every session except the current one.

get.description: Lists the user's non-revoked personal access tokens (never the secrets).

post.summary: Create a personal access token for an MCP client.
post.description: Creates a token. The plaintext is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: Id of the token to revoke
schema.title: Id

parameters.description: Id of the token to revoke

post.summary: Cancel a pending or running background job.
post.description:
Use when the user wants to stop a background operation. A running job stops at
its next checkpoint, so it may still finish. Cancelling a finished job changes nothing.

parameters.name: job_id

schema.description: Job id, as returned when the job was started.
schema.title: Job Id

parameters.description: Job id, as returned when the job was started.

get.summary: Get the state and progress of a background job.
get.description:
Use to check on a long-running operation (file parsing, imports, syncs) that
another capability started and returned a job id for.

parameters.name: job_id

schema.description: Job id, as returned when the job was started.
schema.title: Job Id

parameters.description: Job id, as returned when the job was started.

get.summary: List the user's background jobs, newest first.
get.description:
Use to find recent or running background operations and their outcome.
Do not use to read the data a job produced; use the capability of the module that owns it.

get.summary: Get how much file storage the user has used and their quota.
get.description:
Use when the user asks how much space their files take or why an upload was
rejected for exceeding the quota.

Use when you need the user's language, clock format (12h/24h) or first day of
the week, for example to format a time or date in the way the user expects.
Do not use to read per-module settings such as the calendar default view;
use settings.values.get.

patch.summary: Change personal preferences (language, theme, accent, clock, week start).
patch.description: Partial update: only the fields that are sent change. Not for agents.

get.summary: List every settings namespace with its fields.
get.description:
Use before changing a module setting to find the namespace, the field names,
their allowed values and the levels (account, program, term, course) where they can be set.
Do not use to read current values; use settings.values.get.

post.summary: Read several UI state entries at once.
post.description:
Reads interface state (sort orders, collapsed panels) by key or key prefix.
Not available to agents.

put.description: Stores interface state under a key. Not available to agents.

parameters.name: key

schema.description: '<module>.<what>[.<scopeId>]', at most 128 characters

parameters.description: '<module>.<what>[.<scopeId>]', at most 128 characters

get.summary: Get the effective settings of a module or plugin at a scope.
get.description:
Use when the user asks how a module is configured, e.g. the default calendar
view. Returns the effective value of every field and the level it is inherited from
(default, account, program, term or course).
Do not use for personal preferences such as language or theme; use settings.preferences.get.

patch.summary: Change settings of a module or plugin at one scope level.
patch.description:
Use when the user wants to change a module setting, e.g. make the calendar
open in month view. Only the given fields are set at that level; deeper levels still override them.
Look up namespace and field names with settings.schemas.list first.
Do not use to change language, theme or other personal preferences.
